headline: 3 stories worth your time — mostly marketing & content. Start with: Shopify Unveils Tools for AI-Driven Shopping Experiences and Merchant Success

items.title: Shopify Unveils Tools for AI-Driven Shopping Experiences and Merchant Success
items.summary: Discover how Shopify's latest AI-driven tools are transforming online shopping experiences and empowering merchants to achieve greater success.
items.whyItMatters: Distribution work. Judge it by whether it gets you in front of more of the right people for the same effort.
actions: Check whether your storefront platform supports this natively before adding another subscription.

items.title: Caterpillar is bringing to AI deployment what it learned from automating mining
items.summary: Caterpillar has spent decades putting autonomous machines to work at remote mining sites. It's now bringing that experience to AI deployment.
items.whyItMatters: This is back-office time. Anything here competes directly with hours you are personally spending on admin.
actions: Pick the single most repetitive task in your week and see whether this covers it end to end.

items.title: Oracle Unveils AI-Powered Solutions to Transform Workforce Management
items.summary: Discover how Oracle's latest AI-powered solutions are revolutionizing workforce management, enhancing productivity, and streamlining operations for businesses of all sizes. Stay ahead with cutting-edge technology insights.
items.whyItMatters: Context rather than a task. Useful for deciding what to commit to next quarter and what to ignore.
actions: Background reading — no action needed today, but worth knowing.
